description: Log a day of reading in the linked reader's journal, one entry per book per day, for up to 10 books. Each takes the reader's local date and a note, a position, or both. Position is page for print or ebook, or minutesLeft for audio; a listener's "4 hours in" is totalMinutes minus 240, so it needs the runtime. A Kindle percent goes in the note. A book keeps one unit: a day in the other one comes back unit_differs and logs nothing until switchUnit is true. A note on a day that has one is added under it unless replaceNote is true. A book not on a shelf moves to Reading. Finishing is add_to_library. Notes are private and hold only the reader's words. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

book.description: A title, "Title by Author", or a workId. Books the reader is reading now match first.

date.description: A day in the reader's own time zone, YYYY-MM-DD

minutesLeft.description: Minutes of audio left at the end of that day

note.description: The reader's own words for the day. A page or time this call could not log stays out of it.

page.description: Page reached that day, for a print or ebook copy

replaceNote.description: True only when the reader asked to replace that day's note rather than add to it

switchUnit.description: True only when the reader confirmed moving the book between pages and time

trackBy.description: How the reader follows this book: pages for print or ebook, time for audio

name: write_journal
title: Write in my reading journal
